_about: Original names for unfamiliar proper nouns (src.editor.lint warns when a name's FIRST on-screen mention in an episode lacks the English). Chinese name -> accepted English/local forms, canonical first; keys sharing a canonical form are one name (钻石头山 / 钻石山). Matching ignores case, ʻokina, apostrophes and macrons. Common names (斐济, 萨摩亚, 夏威夷, 汤加, 大溪地) stay out on purpose (creator, #86). Grow it as reviews add names. Not the per-episode edit/glossary.json, which is captions_clean's ASR-fix map.
